reviews.title: This app has gone so downhill
reviews.text: If you’re looking for widgets or customization use literally anything else. I’ve been using this app for YEARS and sadly, it’s gotten to the point that the ads have made it unusable. I absolutely don’t mind watching an ad here and there to use certain features or even when you open the app. I DO mind having an ad in order to save ANY changes whatsoever. It’d also help if the ads at least LET YOU EXIT OUT OF THEM AFTER WATCHING. Half the time I’ll end up having to redo a project multiple times over because an ad keeps freezing or won’t let me close it once it’s done playing so I have to exit out of the app entirely and go back in. You’re also out of your minds if you think I’m going to pay money for a subscription to an app I use to occasionally play around with the widgets on my phone.

reviews.title: Used to really enjoy this app
reviews.text:
I’ve had Photowidget for a few years now. While I’ve used it very sparingly to change my themes, my experience drastically deteriorated this morning. The excessive amount of ads you now have to watch just to save a minor change to any widget is frustrating, never mind basic features (choosing a color that isn’t default, having a specific appearance for a calendar, etc) being locked behind a paywall feels unnecessary and money hungry. I dislike the normalization of subscriptions as it can really subtract from the experience, and this is definitely one of those cases. The paywall has only become more limiting overtime. What’s next?

I used to really enjoy this app, but I can’t say the same now. My experience wasn’t smooth at all, just clunky and riddled with ads. Even just opening the app immediately triggers an ad to pop up. I understand you have to make money somehow, but this is just excessive.

reviews.title: New Update (Dec 2025) made my widgets unusable?
reviews.text:
Please note: my usual review would be 5 stars as this app has been pretty reliable. I know phone customisation can be finicky, so I didn’t mind that maybe once or twice I’ve had to reset a couple of my widgets and things from an update giving them a temporary glitch. But this one seems to not be going away. All my widgets regardless of size or number of app shortcuts they contain are now suddenly useless. None of them redirect to the apps I have them set to (they just go to the Photo Widget home page) and my calendar is frozen on the wrong date (13th Dec). It means I can’t use half my iPad apps now without having to search for the actual app in my phone’s search tab. Clearing and reconnecting the shortcuts via the Photo Widget app, uninstalling and reinstalling the widgets, and hard resetting my iPad hasn’t fixed the issue. However, my individual apps (non widgets) seem to be unaffected. 
I haven’t had to visit the Photo Widget app in a while but noticed there’s now a subscription service in place and I’m wondering if I now need to pay to use the app as watching the ads has also not fixed this issue. 
Devs: any idea what might be the problem?
